sources.title: AI Models verified for OpenVINO™ — OpenVINO™ documentation — Version (2025)
sources.snippet: The results as of September 3rd 2025, for OpenVINO version 2025.3. The models come from different public model repositories, such as Pytorch Model Zoo and HuggingFace; they were executed on the designated hardware with OpenVINO either natively or as a backend.
